answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 52 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in raven, queued in ember, and ivory publishes the wait time. A farm of 143 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4130 identities would post 4931 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
